label: Scrapbook experience
tagline: Raster-heavy collage pieces - vaporwave, cottagecore, Y2K, lo-fi, internetcore, dreamcore, mood-board
description: Crafts deeply-rendered raster-collage pieces where the aesthetic LIVES IN THE IMAGERY rather than in CSS - vaporwave, internetcore, cottagecore, dreamcore, weirdcore, liminalcore, Y2K, lo-fi, mixtape-cover, zine, mood-board, lookbook, Tumblr-grade. The sixth orchestrator sibling. Inherits simulation-orchestrator's discipline (research-then-drawers shape, lens trio with loop-until-bar, multi-draft cruxes via iterator-remix, hand-off split). What changes is purpose: where sim gives understanding, im gives creative-material body, nx gives presence, and game gives agency-toward-objective - scrapbook-experience gives the user A WORLD MADE OF IMAGES. The aesthetic itself is the artefact, communicated through dense raster composition that CSS alone cannot reach. The composition drawer co-dispatches visual-orchestrator per IMAGE INVENTORY entry - this is the most visual-orchestrator-heavy of the six orchestrators. PNG sequences substitute for transparent GIFs (generated frame-by-frame and sprite-sheet-animated). Handcrafted typography is first-class: hand-lettered raster headlines + careful web font choices commissioned via visual-orchestrator. Concept-lens scores against successFeel like 'finding someone's secret Tumblr from 2008' or 'a real polaroid I forgot I took' - never generic claims. Two raster-richness minimums every interactive piece commits by default: ≥1 PNG-sequence 'key visual' that loops like a transparent GIF (the live twitch a static collage misses - a chrome bust rotating, a glitter divider sparkling, a blinking cursor) and ≥1 raster UI element with transparent background (button / nav tab / scroll arrow / marker checkbox / sticker CTA) so interactive controls match the hand-made imagery instead of breaking genre with a CSS rectangle. The research drawer enforces these via the new `ui-element` role + `minPngSequences` / `minUiRasters` envelope fields; waivable only when the brief explicitly rejects motion or interactivity.

triggers.title: Raster-collage / scrapbook / internet-aesthetic piece
triggers.rule: User wants a raster-heavy collage piece anchored to a named internet-aesthetic core (vaporwave / cottagecore / dreamcore / Y2K / lo-fi / mixtape / zine / mood-board / lookbook / internetcore / weirdcore) - where the aesthetic LIVES in the imagery and CSS alone cannot reach it. Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell with `<iframe class="scrapbook-mount" data-scrapbook=...>` slot, then dispatches scrapbook-experience-orchestrator. Same shape as simulation-orchestrator - one consistent flow.
